movers.text: QB Justin Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets; he must clear every step to face New England. He was sacked six times.
QB Drake Maye fractured his right ankle in Week 10 and could miss the rest of the season; Tommy DeVito is expected to start at the Chargers after the bye.
QB Carson Beck (back spasms) missed the 34-7 loss at Kansas City; Mike LaFleur didn't expect a multi-week absence. Josh Johnson started; Gardner Minshew is on IR.
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) missed Sunday's 35-10 loss to San Francisco and remains week-to-week; Kirk Cousins started. WR Jordan Addison (thumb) also sat.
RT Colton McKivitz broke and dislocated his left ankle vs. Minnesota, per Kyle Shanahan, likely ending his season; Vederian Lowe replaced him.

LAC.text: QB Justin Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets; he must clear every step to face New England. He was sacked six times.
LB Daiyan Henley (knee) and CB Tarheeb Still (ankle) were inactive vs. the Jets; the Chargers fell to 1-9.

NE.text: QB Drake Maye fractured his right ankle in Week 10 and could miss the rest of the season; Tommy DeVito is expected to start at the Chargers after the bye.

ARI.text: QB Carson Beck (back spasms) missed the 34-7 loss at Kansas City; Mike LaFleur didn't expect a multi-week absence. Josh Johnson started; Gardner Minshew is on IR.
G Jon Gaines II (ankle) was out a fourth straight game in Week 11.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) missed Sunday's 35-10 loss to San Francisco and remains week-to-week; Kirk Cousins started. WR Jordan Addison (thumb) also sat.

SF.text: RT Colton McKivitz broke and dislocated his left ankle vs. Minnesota, per Kyle Shanahan, likely ending his season; Vederian Lowe replaced him.

IND.text: The Colts released QB Daniel Jones; Shane Steichen named Anthony Richardson the starter going forward, with Riley Leonard as backup.
OTs Bernhard Raimann (concussion) and Jalen Travis (knee) and CBs Sauce Gardner (calf) and Charvarius Ward (knee) were all inactive in the 26-3 loss at Houston.

PHI.text: Joe Milton started the 19-16 win over the Steelers, his second straight start; Jalen Hurts is on IR.
CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) was ruled out in the fourth quarter vs. Pittsburgh; no timeline for Thursday at Dallas. LB Zack Baun (back) is on IR.

DET.text: Secondary: CBs D.J. Reed (hip, third straight game) and Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder) sat Week 11. DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) is out for the season; C Cade Mays is on IR.
S Kerby Joseph played vs. Tampa Bay for the first time this season.

CHI.text: CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) missed the Saints game after not practicing all week; a return for Thanksgiving at Detroit looks unlikely. He is not on IR.

KC.text: G Trey Smith (concussion), OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) and RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) missed Week 11; all are uncertain for Thanksgiving night at Buffalo.

BUF.text: TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) and CB Christian Benford (groin) missed Week 11; WR DJ Moore (knee) left briefly and returned. All face a short week.

DAL.text: CB DaRon Bland (ankle) and S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) are on IR, and G Tyler Booker (high-ankle sprain) missed Week 11.
TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) sat vs. Tennessee; Brian Schottenheimer said he would likely miss multiple weeks.

NO.text: OL: OT Taliese Fuaga, C Erik McCoy and OT Asim Richards were all inactive in the 21-13 loss at Chicago, a second straight game for each.
Defense: LB Pete Werner and CB Martin Emerson Jr. sat at Chicago, and starting S Justin Reid was released at his request.

BAL.text: QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) could return Week 16; Jacoby Brissett started the 35-33 loss at Carolina.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord started the 26-9 loss at Buffalo (102 passing yards).

LV.text: TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) missed Week 11 at Denver; Klint Kubiak is optimistic he plays Nov. 29 at Cleveland.

PIT.text: LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) was ruled out during Sunday's loss at Philadelphia; LB Nick Herbig was inactive. G Mason McCormick is on IR.

JAX.text: OT Walker Little (knee) and CB Jarrian Jones (chest) left Sunday's loss to the Giants; C Robert Hainsey (knee) was inactive.

CIN.text: G Dalton Risner (knees) is ruled out for Monday at Washington; G Dylan Fairchild (oblique) is questionable. QB Joe Burrow (illness) has no designation.
S Kyle Dugger (quadriceps), out six games, is questionable for Monday at Washington.

WAS.text: CB Amik Robertson (ankle) is questionable for Monday vs. Cincinnati; C Lucas Patrick cleared concussion protocol and will start, per Dan Quinn.

GB.text: Edge Micah Parsons (ACL) is on track to make his season debut Wednesday at the Rams, per Fox's Jay Glazer.

LA.text: WR Puka Nacua (knee surgery) is on IR and likely out for the season; WR Davante Adams (hamstring, IR) also stays out.
